body.name: Boundary-adapted cross-fitted Bernoulli series learner
body.construction: For each arm and training sample excluding \(I_k\), maximize the Bernoulli likelihood over \(\log p_a(x)=\alpha\log d_a(x)+\sum_{j=1}^{J_n}\beta_jB_{j,J_n}(x)\), with \(\alpha\ge0\) and \(p_a(x)\in(0,1)\), and select the unique deterministic-ridge-tie-broken maximizer. The same fit is used for every arm: a polynomial-tail arm has \(\alpha=\alpha_a>0\), while an arm bounded at the chart endpoint has \(\alpha=0\). The resulting function is \(\widehat\pi_{a,-k}\).
inputs: the prespecified arm chart and spline dictionary
